name: Lock Screen with FIDO2 Security Key
author: Erijl
description: Unlock the Omarchy lock screen with a FIDO2/U2F security key (YubiKey, Token2, Nitrokey) via pam_u2f: touch to unlock, or PIN + touch on keys that require user verification. Uses its own PAM service, so a mistyped password is never spent against the key's PIN retries.
